Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic RNA pull-down followed by LC-MS/MS to identify interacting proteins (AP-MS). While the paper focuses heavily on H4K5ac (histone acetylation), the mass spectrometry part was used for the RNA pull-down identification of the complex members (ILF3, NF90, ILF2, CBP), not for a global acetylome enrichment. Therefore, mod_ap_ms is the correct modifier rather than mod_acetyl.

scope: RNA pull-down assay, the procedure was following as previously Dr. Yang’s Laboratory developed.
The RNA-captured beads were then washed once with NT2 buffer... and incubated with 20 mg of cell lysates at 4°C for at least 4–6 h with gentle rotation.
The RNA-binding protein complexes were washed with serial high-salt buffers and then resolved by gel electrophoresis. The gel was stained with Coomassie blue and then excised for mass spectrometry.

The RNA pull-down proteins were separated by SDS-PAGE and visualized by Coomassie blue staining. The proteins in excised gel bands were digested by trypsin and performed LC–MS/MS analysis using reverse-phase HPLC coupled with Orbitrap Elite.
